title: WISDOM Project - XXII. A 5 per cent precision CO-dynamical supermassive black hole mass measurement in the galaxy NGC 383
question: Measure the supermassive black hole mass in the nearby lenticular galaxy NGC 383 with unprecedented spatial resolution and precision using ALMA CO(2-1) dynamical modelling.

recipe.goal: Calibrate, flag, self-calibrate, and image the 1.3 mm continuum emission and measure its properties
recipe.method: Calibrate tracks with ALMA pipeline, manually flag edge-channel noise spikes in continuum SPWs using flagdata, exclude the first C43-10 track due to poor weather decorrelation, concatenate the remaining four tracks with concat, perform two rounds of phase-only self-calibration with gaincal, image with tclean in MFS mode, and fit a 2D Gaussian with imfit.
key_parameters: Self-calibration solution intervals decreased from 5 to 1 min; Högbom deconvolver; pixel size 0.01 arcsec; image size 960 × 960 pixels; Briggs robust = 2
assumptions: No spectral dependence in multi-frequency synthesis continuum imaging

recipe.goal: Image the 12CO(2-1) line cube, create moment maps and PVDs, and measure corrected total line flux
recipe.method: Apply continuum self-calibration to line SPWs, subtract continuum in uv-plane with uvcontsub, image CO(2-1) cube with tclean, generate masked moment maps and PVDs, and compute true total CO flux correcting for clean/dirty beam area mismatch via Jorsater & van Moorsel (1995).
key_parameters: Briggs robust = 0.5 (and robust = 2.0 for warp/non-circular motion analysis); channel width 20 km s^-1; rest frequency 230.538 GHz; clean threshold 1.5 sigma_RMS; moment mask smoothed by 3× beam FWHM spatially and 11 channels Hanning spectrally, clipped at 0.5 sigma_RMS; PVD slit width 15 pixels along PA 142 deg
assumptions: Linear frequency dependence for continuum subtraction in uvcontsub

recipe.goal: Construct the stellar mass model via Multi-Gaussian Expansion (MGE) and Jeans Anisotropic Modelling (JAM)
recipe.method: Fit a regularised MGE model to a combined masked HST NICMOS F160W and 2MASS H-band image deconvolved with the HST TinyTim PSF, deproject to a 3D axisymmetric stellar light distribution, and compute the stellar circular velocity curve using JAM with a radially linearly varying mass-to-light ratio plus a point-mass SMBH.
key_parameters: 6 MGE Gaussian components (Table 3); linearly varying M/L between R = 0 (M/L_inner) and R = 3.5 arcsec (M/L_outer), constant at R > 3.5 arcsec
assumptions: Gravitational potential in the nuclear region is dominated by stars and the SMBH (molecular gas, ionised gas, dust, and dark matter are negligible); axisymmetric 3D stellar light distribution sharing inclination with the gas disc; D = 66.6 Mpc

recipe.goal: Sample the deconvolved molecular gas distribution and fit the 3D dynamical model to the CO data cube to measure M_BH
recipe.method: Sample the deconvolved tclean CLEAN components into 4.1 × 10^6 gas particles using SkySampler, re-fit the intermediate-resolution cube to derive informative priors on inclination and M/L, and fit the unmasked high-resolution CO data cube using KinMS with MCMC chi^2 minimisation.
key_parameters: 4.1 × 10^6 gas particles; 10 free parameters; N = 404,722 detected pixels; uncertainty rescaling factor (2N)^0.25; 10^5 MCMC steps
assumptions: Circular gas orbits in an unwarped thin disc; spatially constant gas velocity dispersion; diagonal covariance matrix; morphological centre coincides with phase centre while kinematic centre is offset

recipe.goal: Model the central velocity twist using tilted-ring and parametric warp/radial-motion models to test impact on M_BH
recipe.method: Re-image the CO data cube with natural weighting (robust = 2.0), fit non-parametric tilted-ring warp and radial motion models using 3DBarolo 3DFIT, and fit parametric PA warp and linear radial motion models using KinMS.
key_parameters: 3DBarolo: 20 rings of width 0.06 arcsec out to 1.2 arcsec, z_0 = 0, TWOSTAGE=true, mask clipped at 1 sigma_RMS; KinMS: 12 free parameters for warp model (PA_inner, PA_outer, R_change) and radial motion model (V_rad,0, R_cutoff)
assumptions: Infinitely thin disc (z_0 = 0) in 3DBarolo; either pure PA warp (V_rad = 0) or pure linear radial motion with fixed PA/inclination
